## Contract and outcomes

Pass an HTMLElement and EditorOptions with the explicit existing checkpoint identity, asset URL and local storage ports. createEditor returns a handle immediately; await ready before input. setReadOnly changes this view's editing gate. destroy returns unsaved and recovery information; choose flush or report and retain returned recovery bytes.

## Errors and recovery

WASM loading, incompatible identity/schema or local recovery can reject readiness. Inspect state.error, preserve the checkpoint/journal and retry with compatible assets. A failed or closing view cannot accept commands.

## Prerequisites and platform limits

Browser DOM and IndexedDB consumer only. SSR must not mount or access browser globals. React/Astro lifecycle tutorials remain pending; this is no SSR or native qualification.
